description: Fires when the opponent is building the bottom-left diagonal (0,0)-(1,1)-(2,2)-(3,3) (a1-d4): they hold at least 3 of those 4 cells and I hold none, i.e. they threaten the 4th cell; also when they hold (1,1),(3,3),(4,4) with (2,2) empty. Opponent holding only (0,0)+(1,1) gives weak, inconsistent activation. Own stones on that diagonal, the mirror diagonal, or shifted diagonals do not make it fire.
effect: Modest: when forced high it shifts move probability toward the far-left columns (0/1, e.g. +0.14 to +0.38) and away from columns 3/4; zeroing it does the reverse. Column 2 is not raised.
notes: Initial impression (empty column flanked by tall ones) was wrong: pure wells give ~0, and activation flips with side to move. Minimal pairs pinpointed opponent stones on (0,0),(1,1),(2,2),(3,3); dropping any one of 3 drops activation from 6 to ~1; mirror/shifted diagonals and my own diagonal give ~0. Dev scores: p1 (>=2 theirs) F1 0.44; p2 (>=3 in either window) 0.53; p3 (require (2,2) empty) 0.53; p4 (final) F1 0.650, P 0.54, R 0.81, AUROC 0.90, sim share 0.95; p5 (pair also fires) 0.60. Exceptions: some late-game diagonal threats are silent; pair-only cases fire about half the time; context effects not captured. Synthesis beats dev max (16.84 vs 15.91).
